programme.title: South Park: Hooden invaderar

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper inte

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten
programme.desc: Cartman tar jultomten, Mr. Hankey och Jesus till hjälp för att försöka skänka julkänsla till de förtryckta massorna i Irak - allt för att hamna på tomtens lista över snälla barn.

programme.title: South Park: Dansar med smurfar
programme.desc: Cartman blir utnämnd till att läsa upp morgonnyheterna i högtalarna på South Park Elementary.

programme.title: South Park: Endast medlemmar
programme.desc: Den tillträdande presidenten besöker sin hemstad.

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs moster Flo har presenter till Shelly och Stan. Shelly får en fantastiskt stereo medan Stans present är en fisk som ser ganska läskig ut.

programme.title: South Park: Döda barn
programme.desc: Randy försöker desperat hjälpa Sharon få kontroll på känslorna, och Cartman misslyckas oväntat nog på matematikprovet.

programme.title: South Park: Banka min bäver
programme.desc: Ike hamnar i puberteten och han och Kyle glider isär. För att de ska komma varandra närmare tar Kyle med Ike för att se 'Yo Gabba Gabba!' live.

programme.title: South Park: En elefant älskar med en gris
programme.desc: Kyle anlitar dr Mephisto, som jobbar med genteknik, för att klona hans elefant och Cartmans knubbiga gris för att vinna en naturvetenskapstävling.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman är övertygad om att flickorna har en manick som kan se in i framtiden, så Butters klär ut sig till tjej för att infiltrera deras läger.

programme.title: South Park: Vad händer med landet?
programme.desc: Garrison vill bygga en mur för att hålla papperslösa invandrare borta.

programme.title: South Park: Femlingar 2000
programme.desc: Pressen följer med stort intresse en familj med femlingar som flyttar till South Park och Cartman blir vän med en av dem. Kennys mamma försöker tjäna en slant genom att föda sin egen barnkull.

programme.title: South Park: Å jösses!
programme.desc: Gerald står öga mot öga med Trolljägaren.

programme.title: South Park: Tonsilltrubbel
programme.desc: En klantigt utförd blodöverföring leder till att Cartman får AIDS. Hur långt kan han tänka sig att gå för att hitta ett botemedel?

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Heidi lyckas få en intervju för sitt drömjobb, vilket får henne att fundera på att hoppa av skolan för gott och får Lauren att inse att hon och Heidi kan vara inne på helt olika banor.

programme.title: Love and Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop business owners despise each other in real life, but fall in love while unknowingly sending each other messages via a dating app on their friends’ behalf.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. With a little nudging from the matchmaking daughter, Sophie and Michael unexpectedly start to fall in love and Sophie must decide between returning home or following her heart.

programme.title: The Dating List
programme.desc: Career driven Abby agrees to help her busy boss find the man of her dreams, but she encounters a dilemma when she starts falling for the same man her boss approves of dating.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, a stubborn, difficult, but influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece’s 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårt arbetande mamma tar med sina barn på en utmanande roadtrip efter mannens svek.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren är i pengaknipa och Jimmy jagar svunna tiders framgångar på tennisbanorna och därför återförenas de för ett minst sagt optimistiskt försök att kvala in till en Grand Slam-turnering. Med Jeremy Sisto, Adam Devine och Oscar vinnande J.K. Simmons

programme.title: The Catcher Was a Spy
programme.desc: En ovanlig spion utför ett hemligt uppdrag under andra världskriget, där verklighet och bedrägeri konfronteras i en intensiv kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Supercool
programme.desc: Bästa vännerna Neil (Jake Short) och Gilbert (Miles J. Harvey) är trötta på att vara losers. De drömmer om samma liv som grannen Jimmy (Damon Wayans Jr.) vilken har ett överflöd av snabba bilar och vilda fester.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Big Momma är tillbaka! Rikets säkerhet är hotad och FBI-agenten Malcolm Turner måste återigen ikläda sig rollen som Big Momma.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Marvels femme fatale; Elektra (Garner) bevisar att utseende kan döda när den sexigaste actionhjälten någonsin bryter sig ut från serietidningssidorna till filmduken. I sitt nya uppdrag tvingas hon fatta ett ödesdigert beslut i kampen mellan gott och ont!

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: I en värld där "puppets" lever bland människor, men inte riktigt har uppnåt samma status, jobbar detektiv Phil. Han återförenas med sin forna partner, detektiv Connie Edwards för att hitta den som mördade detektiv Phils bror.

programme.title: Umeå4Ever
programme.desc: Stian är 31 år och har länge kämpat med kärleken och till slut har han skruvat ner på kraven så mycket att han nästan är beredd att nöja sig med den som vill ha honom.

programme.title: Det Enda Rationella
programme.desc: Erland arbetar på ett pappersbruk i en mindre industriort tillsammans med bäste vännen Sven-Erik. På fritiden driver han en äktenskapsskola i kyrkans regi tillsammans med sin fru May. På en fest drabbas han av en häftig förälskelse när han möter Sven-Eriks fru Karin.

programme.title: Anti
programme.desc: Året är 1991. Simon och hans bästa kompis Frede lever i en förortsbubbla utanför Köpenhamn utan andra framtidsdrömmar än nästa joint som ska rullas. Simon har alltid älskat att rita, men har aldrig trott att hans talang skulle kunna användas till något.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Illegal streetracing, alkohol och kärlek för stunden är alltsammans saker som håller intresset vid liv för ett rastlöst och adrenalinhungrigt kompisgäng.

programme.title: Triple Dare
programme.desc: Rebekka, Claudia och Sofie är 15 år. Trots att de är konfirmerade så känner de varje dag att de befinner sig i gränslandet mellan att vara barn och att vara vuxen.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: De började med att skapa en undergroundwebbplats och kom att bli världens mest efterlysta personer.

programme.title: White Oleander
programme.desc: I ett anfall av sjuklig svartsjuka förgiftar den kompromisslösa och förföriska konstnären Ingrid sin älskare. Hon döms till livstids fängelse och hennes 15-åriga dotter Astrid får därefter flytta runt mellan olika fosterfamiljer. Dottern försöker desperat att skapa sig en egen identitet.

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Stet, en orolig och arg 11-årig föräldralös son från en liten stad i Texas, hamnar på en pojkkörskola i östra Texas efter sin ensamstående mammas död.
En ung författare tvingas att acceptera sin dödlighet när han diagnoseras med en sällsynt form av cancer. Med hjälp av sin bästa vän och en ung terapeut finner han modet att möta sjukdomen.

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro är den amerikanska drömmen förkroppsligad. Som Hollywoods mest efterfrågade talangscout tillhör han filmstadens absoluta grädda. Snabba bilar, välfyllda bankkonton och en vacker hustru - you name it, Jack's got it.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Vad gör att en kvinna sveper höger för fel kille och vänster för den rätte? Den faktaorienterade neuroforskaren Julias forskning om hur den kvinnliga och den manliga hjärnan fungerar illustreras med hjälp av tre olika par i olika faser i deras förhållanden.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Josh och Cornelia är ett urbant 40-årskrisande par i New York som försökt skaffa barn, men inte lyckats och har bestämt sig för att vara nöjda med det. När de lär känna två unga hipsters, Jamie och Darby, överger de snabbt sina jämnåriga vänner som startat familj och slagit sig till ro.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: En komisk vriden historia om en dysfunktionell familj som samlas för att sörja sin patriarks bortgång. Daniels far har just avlidit och det enda han vill är att genomföra begravningen som planerat, vilket inte är det lättaste med en galen familj på halsen.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Sådan far sådan son
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence i komedirollen som Big Momma, en skojfrisk tant från Södern med mängder av tokiga tricks i bakfi ckan.

programme.desc: En attraktion uppstår när en kinesisk-amerikansk flicka som besöker Hongkong för första gången möter en amerikansk utlandsbo som visar henne vägen, men timingen kanske inte riktigt är på deras sida.

programme.title: Griffin & Phoenix
programme.desc: När Griffin har fått diagnosen att han har dödlig cancer bestämmer han sig för att ta livet i egna händer och ha lite kul innan han dör. Samtidigt som tiden för hans liv rinner ut träffar han och blir kär i Phoenix - som också har en hemlighet.

programme.desc: When it comes to romance, Patrick Dempsey delivers in this madcap comedy. Working his way through college as a pizza delivery boy, Dempsey learns a few lessons in love from bored housewives who are looking for more than anchovies on their pizza.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: Commencement ceremony is over, it's time for Huntington High's graduation party as jocks, geeks, prom queens, and misfits alike make a statement about the past and plot the uncertain future in this raucous comedy.

programme.title: The Wedding Planner
programme.desc: A wedding planner finally meets "Mr. Right", but he's the groom from one of her upcoming weddings.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier, Season: 4, Episode: 3
programme.desc: Mountain man Jim Baker risks his life to save a group of trappers in an epic frontier battle.

programme.title: Bonanza, Season: 2, Episode: 8
programme.desc: When Little Joe and Hoss spend an evening at the carnival, Little Joe's date disappears.

programme.title: Bonanza, Season: 2, Episode: 9
programme.desc: Little Joe's friend, Dolly Kincaid is always falling in with the wrong kind. Joe tries to save her.

programme.title: The Young Land
programme.desc: When an American gunslinger kills a Mexican man in California immediately in the aftermath of the Mexican-American War, he is arrested and put on trial for murder. The local population is anxious to see if justice will prevail.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way, Season: 2, Episode: 8
programme.desc: Bubba reveals he's leaving, Booger and Jaclyn move in together, and everyone gives thanks.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way, Season: 3, Episode: 1
programme.desc: Bubba struggles in the office, Cody manages a steer mishap, and Booger adjusts to married life.

programme.title: Cream of the Crop
programme.desc: High-school Ag Science teacher Jodi Stafford meets commercial real-estate marketing specialist Mike Jared during her struggle to save her family's ailing dairy farm.

programme.title: It's a Fixer Upper
programme.desc: When The Dovers find they’re in financial jeopardy, the only answer is to sell the house Anne’s parent’s left her. But when no one wants to buy it, they decide the only way to get rid of the house is to fix it up.

programme.title: Rosemont
programme.desc: Caught in a blizzard five days before Christmas, pregnant 23-year-old Lisa, and her new friend Brad, a professional snowboarder, take shelter at The Rosemont. A once great winter resort, The Rosemont has seen better days. After losing her daughter and granddaughter, the cantankerous owner Josephine has let it fall into disrepair. But now, stranded by the blizzard, with Lisa giving birth, everyone comes together to provide what they all need most – a family.

programme.title: A Taste of Tuscany
programme.desc: April is a health chef guru who goes to Italy to learn how to incorporate the country’s rich culture of food in her own recipes. April finds new joy and freedom in life and cooking – and also love.

programme.title: Finding Love in Big Sky
programme.desc: An independent country girl, Paisley, takes on the task of upholding her adored grandfather’s ranch. After being denied the funding needed to refurbish the ranch, she is reintroduced to her ex-boyfriend Josh, a big-time marketing executive stationed in Denver who has been suspended from his current position at his company. Admitting to herself that she needs the help, Paisley agrees to work with Josh while he is town to come up with ideas on how to raise money for the farm.

programme.title: Twisted Marriage
programme.desc: Dexter and Ashley are a married couple, who are close friends with Mary and Paul. On a whim, they decide to swing spouses for the weekend, which leads to questions about their feelings and if their marriages will survive.

programme.title: The Jealous Son
programme.desc: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

programme.title: The Special Affect
programme.desc: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

programme.title: Kinfolk
programme.desc: Eboni, is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown. Her feuding family complicates her plans, but her dedication and drive, along with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Meanwhile, their estranged father's attempts to reconcile with his past create further challenges.

programme.title: Women of the Jury
programme.desc: A man is on trial accused of murder of two young black men, and twelve women are called to serve on the jury. After deliberation, one juror is convinced the man is not guilty, while the majority claims he is guilty. A conversation takes place consisting of arguments, alliances, and near violence. What will the verdict be?

programme.title: Scama O'Rama
programme.desc: Two friends, Charles and Nebu battle with survival in the city of Lagos, Nigeria and after searching and struggling to secure any meaningful paying jobs decide to create a fake insurance scheme to defraud unsuspecting victims. Their plan works until a friend reveals their plot to the authorities.

programme.title: First Born
programme.desc: A grade six boy Langcer Divine (Frubi Rollins) is caught in a web of abuse and neglect by his school teachers and peers because of his dullness. He is refused to be registered as an internal candidate for the Common Entrance Examination, as the school wishes to uphold its reputation of academic excellence. Back at home, Divine being the lone child to his parents, goes through emotional torture as they scold at him at every given opportunity. In the midst of his pain and dark clouds, his class teacher Mr. Pangala Nicodemus (Tampy Livinus) comes to his rescue by unraveling a biblical revelation 'Exodus 13:2'. It is discovered that Divine as a first born to his parents, inherited a curse. Could this have been the cause of his dullness or was he a victim of stigmatization and hate by a school system that cares for bright pupils and its reputation to the detriment of slow learners?

programme.title: Best Of..
programme.desc: Best Of is a vibrant, fast-paced lifestyle TV show that takes viewers on a captivating journey through diverse industries. Each episode features in-depth interviews with top professionals and innovators in their respective fields.

programme.title: Best Of..
programme.desc: Best Of is a vibrant, fast-paced lifestyle TV show that takes viewers on a captivating journey through diverse industries. Each episode features in-depth interviews with top professionals and innovators in their respective fields.

programme.title: Tom Dick and Harrie
programme.desc: "Tom, Dick, and Harrie" is a hilarious web series that unfolds the comedic tale of two roommates - Tom and Dick - facing the financial strain of rent. To alleviate their burden, they decide to find a third roommate through a social media ad. Enter Harrie, a mysterious new tenant who happens to be Dick's ex-girlfriend, Harriet. Harriet seizes the opportunity to re-enter Dick's life in an unconventional way; disguising herself as a guy named Harrie and secretly paying for a room in their apartment. When Dick discovers the ruse, he proposes a temporary truce, agreeing to cohabitate for a month until Harrie can find alternative accommodation. What ensues is a rollercoaster of comedic episodes as the once lovebirds navigate the challenges of living together again. Will the close quarters and shared experiences rekindle their old flame, or will it lead to more chaos and hilarity? Join Tom, Dick, and the disguised Harrie as they embark on a month-long journey that unravels into unexpected twists and turns. Discover whether this unusual living arrangement sparks a new chapter in their relationships and buckle up for a laughter-filled ride in "Tom, Dick, and Harrie."

programme.title: Live Connections: Runtown
programme.desc: "Get ready for a captivating experience with 'Soundgod' Afrobeats Artist Runtown and his band. In this one-hour special, follow Runtown, his talented dancers, and the dedicated film crew as they prepare for a spectacular live event in London.

programme.title: The Coffin Salesman
programme.desc: Uwem is a small town business man who has hit hard times as he has not made sales because he lives in a town where everyone is exercising, quitting smoking and generally trying to live healthier lifestyles. This isn’t good for his business as sales are seriously reduced. His problems are compounded when his wife leaves him and he is left with their daughter Nse who is suspended from school for refusing to take off her superhero costume. Uwem has to also contend with the aggressive takeover of his new neighbor HD Yaw who owns KPAI Assassination Limited and covets his small business. Everything comes to a head when he meets Ogun Lesley who is dying and has a list of odd things he wants to do before he goes…and this becomes Uwem’s most important coffin sale

programme.title: Sophia
programme.desc: Sophia has always dreamed of becoming a top influencer, but her big break never seems to come. When she sees her friend trapped in an abusive relationship, she sees the perfect opportunity to skyrocket into fame.

programme.title: The Special One
programme.desc: Innocent, naive Leyla falls for badboy Deji against her parents' wish and her fiancé's displeasure. Will their decisions lead to happiness or heartbreak?

programme.title: Warm Encounter
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Kunle is in a loveless marriage with Bisi, after she falls pregnant, and he is forced to marry her. They both feel stuck in this marriage, and this causes resentment to rise between them. Things start to change when Kunle starts to get close to Ivie, a tutor hired by Bisi for their daughter.

programme.title: Composure
programme.desc: A marriage begins to suffer after the couple lose their unborn child. Things take a turn for the worse when the wife discovers her husband has been unfaithful and her mental health starts to spiral out of control.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lynchningen
programme.desc: När en småstadsmobb lägger skulden på en pojke för mordet på en omtyckt lokal kvinna kallas Walker in för att stoppa den arga gruppen från att lyncha ynglingen medan han försöker bevisa hans oskuld.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Forsränning, del 1 / Forsränning, del 2
programme.desc: Alex tar Walker på forsränning, men semestern tar snabbt en dödlig vändning.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Överenskommelsen
programme.desc: När Walkers bästa karateelev i en klass innerstadsungdomar går med i ett latinamerikanskt gäng för att hämnas en drive-by-skjutning som skadade hans bror försöker Walker stoppa det vettlösa kriget och bringa julfred till ett söndrat område.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Rodeo
programme.desc: När en känd maffialedare blir villkorligt frigiven hittas två av tre vittnen som vittnade mot honom döda och Walker måste skydda det tredje.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Krutdurk
programme.desc: När avfällingar från Irländska republikanska armén försöker lönnmörda en dignitär som förhandlar fram ett fredsavtal mellan IRA och Storbritannien måste Walker och Trivette hitta lönnmördaren eller riskera att utlösa en internationell incident.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Inbrott
programme.desc: När ett skyddat vittne dödas medan Walker och Trivette vaktar honom, och en maffiamedlem kan släppas ur fängelset på grund av det, går Walker under täckmantel som en dömd lönnmördare i maxsäkerhetsfängelset för att tvinga fram en mordbekännelse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: LaRues återkomst
programme.desc: Även om Alex framgångsrikt åtalade Victor LaRue, mannen som kidnappade och försökte våldta henne, plågar minnet henne fortfarande och hon blir livrädd när han släpps ut ur fängelset på grund av en teknikalitet och söker hämnd.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Roger discovers the secret of Jeannie's existence when he accidentally releases her from her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Roger keeps Sheila, Dr. Bellows' niece, out long past her uncle's curfew.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie the government is sending him to Rome.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. programme.title: The Sidwell’s: Steve and Krysy Sidwell on Marriage, Teenage Tear-Ups and Book Club Blunders
programme.desc: On today’s episode of The Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter are joined by some of their oldest and closest friends - Steve and Krysy Sidwell. In a friendship spanning two decades which has seen the couples share career paths, holidays and some outrageous nights out, this podcast is full of laughs and a behind the curtain, sneak peak into what it’s like being best friends with your favourite pair of podcasters! Steve and Krysy discuss what they think has made their 20 year marriage stay rock solid after all these years and how they are navigating having three teenage boys who have developed of penchant for knocking seven bells of sh*t out of each other on a regular basis. In the Agony Ab section, we hear from a listener who has some concerns about his wife’s recent fashion choices as well what to do in the awkward situation when someone likes you more than you like them - so stay tuned for that!! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - Will You Marry Me?
programme.desc: This week, Abbey and Peter provide a schooling session on how to nail the perfect proposal (spoiler: It does not involve chemtrails) Weekly Whine club is also back, with Abbey and Peter going a bit more upmarket to celebrate the roaring success that is The Therapy Crouch! We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Therapy Crouch! On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You’re Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. Do they know what a spicebag is? Can they tell the difference between real and fake Irish sayings? And can they identify some iconic Irish people?

programme.title: Gen Z Watch Little Britain, Fat Families & Jeremy Kyle For The First Time
programme.desc: Gen Z watches Little Britain, Fat Families, and The Jeremy Kyle Show for the first time and gives their honest reactions to some of the most unhinged British television ever made. From outrageous sketches to brutal reality TV moments, they explore whether it was funny, uncomfortable, or both.

programme.title: Chris Pratt Takes On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Pratt takes on the ultimate British test as he attempts some of the UK's most iconic accents. From London to the North, see how well he really knows British voices and culture.

programme.title: Chris O’Dowd Plays Time Capsule
programme.desc: Chris O'Dowd becomes the first guest to take on the brand new Time Capsule format, building a personal capsule with items connected to his life, career, childhood and biggest memories. He discusses Bridesmaids sequel talk and possible MCU ambitions, the Dublin versus London debate, and shares stories and nostalgic moments throughout.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Average Joe
programme.desc: Average Joe speaks with workers from the Galway Rape Crisis Centre about their free services. They discuss the importance of listening and believing survivors of sexual violence, the role of art therapy in supporting trauma processing, and why you don't need the right words or a label to reach out for help. t.

programme.title: Will Arnett & John Bishop Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Hollywood star Will Arnett and British comedian John Bishop take on the ultimate British Test. From debating if British people are polite to sampling classic British food, tea etiquette, and slang — this duo delivers laughs, charm, and plenty of friendly rivalry. Who's the real British expert? Watch Will Arnett and John Bishop take on the challenge and find out.

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians - Hélène Landemore Interview
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

programme.title: Who Broke Britain's Energy System?
programme.desc: Arthur Downing, an energy expert, discusses his book Power and the People, which charts the history of British energy and how the system became broken.

programme.title: When Hasan Piker Met Jeremy Corbyn
programme.desc: Jeremy Corbyn is no stranger to media and political pile-ons. Neither is Hasan Piker. Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." The interview proceeded regardless.

programme.title: We Teach Old People Gen Z Slang
programme.desc: A group of pensioners attempt to decode the mysterious and ever-evolving slang of Gen Z. From "gyatt" to "rage baiting", and "glizzy", these golden oldies give their unfiltered, often baffled, and always entertaining takes. Will they master the lingo or be left completely gobsmacked? Featuring genuine reactions, unexpected laughs, and a wholesome generational culture clash that's both cringe and heartwarming in equal measure.

programme.title: Trump's Greenland Deal Isn't What You Think
programme.desc: Ava is joined by Scott Lucas to break down the latest developments in Donald Trump's political moves. They discuss Trump's recent trip to New York where he met Andy Burnham face-to-face, and analyse the major story from the UN: the long-awaited "deal" on Greenland.

programme.title: Trump Will Lead To America's Downfall - Owen Jones Interview
programme.desc: Owen Jones makes his PolJOE debut to discuss Western decline and his book The Fall of the West. He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man

We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lim Heon-il episode 185
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Lim Heon-il! This artist made his big debut in the music scene after winning the Bronze Award at the 15th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest in 2004. Since then he has actively pursued his career both as a guitarist and vocalist. As a guitarist he has played for a number of Korea's top artists including Kim Dong-ryul Lim Jae-beom and Lee So-ra. He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ONEWE episode 188
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung-hwan episode 189
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is superb vocalist Jung Seung-hwan! With his trademark heartwarming voice this artist is known for his winter songs including The Snowman and My Christmas Wish. In time for the season he's back with another winter classic - Winter Again. Topping all the major charts with his latest single he once again proved his mainstream popularity. Also he took part in the song Our Christmas Wish For You released by his label and genuinely comforted listeners going through this difficult time. In this episode Jung Seung-hwan performs The Snowman Whenever Wherever Fine and more to keep us warm during this cold season. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented vocalist!

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In 1994, 25-year-old Toni Dykstra of Los Angeles, the single mother of two young daughters, met and married Carlo Ventre, a successful 46-year-old Italian businessman. After Toni gave birth to their child, Santina, the couple's relationship soured.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets From The Grave
programme.desc: Bill Flint spent his life cheating death -- not once, not twice, but three times. His friends say this is a story of how a lot of bad things happened to a really good person.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Black Dahlia Confidential
programme.desc: The brutal murder in 1947 of Elizabeth Short, a young, struggling actress whose body was discovered in a vacant lot in January 1947, has baffled the Los Angeles Police Department for decades

programme.title: 48 Hours: Blaming the Babysitter
programme.desc: A frantic 13-year-old, Ashley Howes, calls 911 because the toddler she's babysitting won't wake up. Prosecutors are convinced Ashley Howes shook 19-month-old Freya Garden to death. They charge Howes with second degree murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Informer
programme.desc: A report on the moral dilemma faced by Jim Morel, a Massachusetts musician, who was told by another musician friend, Jason Weir, that the 2001 death of Marina Calabro, the aunt of their bandmate Anthony Calabro, though ruled an accident, was murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Proposal
programme.desc: Stephanie Pepper Sims was a college professor in the prime of her life when she suddenly vanished without a trace. Estranged from her husband, Stephanie moved in with a lover. Eventually, a hand-drawn map would lead investigators her body.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Duty, Death, Dishonor
programme.desc: 25-year-old U.S. Army Specialist Richard Davis took part in the March 2003 invasion of Iraq. After celebrating his homecoming with four Army buddies, he disappeared and was listed by the Army as AWOL. A tip led to the discovery of his body.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Ride
programme.desc: Jane Mixer, a student at the University of Michigan Law School in March of 1969, had just agreed to get married and had arranged a ride home to tell her parents. Her body was found in a small, rural cemetery just miles from her dorm.

programme.title: On the Case: Sirens in the Night
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the shocking discovery of a mysterious young woman who is found in the ashes of a fire.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Dance
programme.desc: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood and Betrayal
programme.desc: A military police officer is found murdered in her own home, sending police on a twisted journey for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery in the Mountains
programme.desc: After a young woman disappears from her mountain home, it looks like the case will never be solved. Then, a retired FBI profiler joins the cold case team and jump starts a 13 year old investigation.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Offer
programme.desc: After coming to the aid of a stranded roommate, Stephanie Brown's car is found abandoned on the interstate and her body is later discovered floating in an irrigation ditch, the victim of sexual assault and murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Ray of Darkness
programme.desc: Police must connect two vicious murders in order to bring a single killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programme.desc: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programme.title: On the Case: Campus Killer
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing from her university campus, her mother is forced to lead an investigation for the truth. Can she find her precious daughter before it's too late?

programme.title: Britain's Newsroom
programme.desc: Andrew and Miriam present Monday to Friday mornings. When the news happens, it happens here. But what does it mean for you? GB News brings you the biggest stories and the answers you need from across the UK.

programme.title: Good Afternoon Britain
programme.desc: Tackling the big stories from all angles and perspectives. Weekdays from midday.

programme.title: Martin Daubney
programme.desc: Join Martin for an up-to-the-minute take on the day's events delivered in his own unique and lively style.

programme.title: East Asia Tonight 2026/2027
programme.desc: Spotlight on East Asia, a region steeped in history and now helping to write the future of our world. We'll break down the key stories and explain why they matter.

programme.title: A Frame In Time
programme.desc: Singapore 1959. Why were residents especially the Chinese attending Malay language classes? Chua Mia Tee's painting reveals the significance of these classes and its impact on nation-building.

programme.title: Asia Tonight 2026/2027

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars är en älskvärd introvert man vars emotionella bagage har hållit honom ifrån livsbejakelse. Efter år av ensamhet bjuder han in Bianca, en vän han mött på internet, för att möta honom. Han introducerar Bianca för sin bror och hans fru och de är förstummade.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Tyler Hawkins lever ett rotlöst liv och släpper ingen inpå livet. Kärlek står långt ner på önskelistan - tills han träffar Ally. Hennes mod och spontanitet inspirerar Tyler att släppa efter och tillåta sig att känna lycka och mening med livet.

programme.title: Before Midnight
programme.desc: Nu har det snart gått tjugo år sedan Céline och Jesse träffades på ett tåg i Wien. Det fransk-amerikanska paret bor i Paris med sina tvillingdöttrar, men tillbringar sommaren i Grekland. Där utmynnar en middagsbjudning i ett gräl som hotar att knäcka deras förhållande ännu en gång.

programme.title: Zombie och spöktåget
programme.desc: Zombie (Silu Seppälä: Leningrad Cowboys) är en individ som går sin egen väg och inte kan följa de normer som det finska samhället har satt för honom. Zombie beslutar sig för att lämna allt och ge sig utomlands - till en plats där ingen förväntar sig något av honom.
